|lore=Made on Dantooine. Luke used the many pockets in his gundark-skin backpack to carry supplies while on patrol.
|game_text=Deploy on any character. May carry and use any number of devices. May also carry Yoda, Kabe or any one Jawa or Ewok (as if riding a creature vehicle). Adds 1 to training destiny when carrying the Mentor.

* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Device: Luke's Backpack, Dagobah, R
|rulings=* Does not allow the character to use devices that they cannot use otherwise.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Luke%27s%20Backpack</ref>
* The character in the backpack is not enclosed within it.
* The character in the backpack still occupies capacity slots on starships and vehicles.
* If character with the backpack leaves table, the character inside automatically disembarks (even if they may not move).
* If either character is to be made captured, missing, or excluded from battle, the other is also affected, and the character in the backpack automatically disembarks (even if they may not move).
* The backpack may not be transferred to the character currently inside it.
